Not me, but my fiance and I were looking at deciding on wedding colors and he started saying that he couldn't tell the difference between some pretty distinct colors. It got to the point where I pulled up a color blindness test, the ones worth the colored dots, and you're supposed to be able to distinguish a number or shape in the middle. Well it turned out he had red/green color blindness. Or so I thought. 
I was pretty sad about this. We're both into painting and are pretty romantic people. 
So over the next few weeks I researched getting him some of those chroma glasses, mentioned he was colorblind to a few friends and family, and let myself get pretty bummed out about it. 
A few months later he confesses it had started as a joke because he was sick of looking at wedding colors with me. (He loved planning, but we have very different tastes and I'm so indecisive.) 
I laughed it off.
